DZA.note: Nothing on digital finance consumer protection.
Only one ministry's property-liability check using data exchange with other sectors; no exchange platform named.
Payments are by citizens to the AADL housing programme, not government payments to people.
No survey share of adults with accounts.
Electronic payment of housing instalments is stated without naming a mobile money or e-money service.
Housing price and rent payments are not taxes or fees to the revenue authority.
